name: Iromie: Color Vision & Aging Experience
summary:
"What if you could see the world through someone else's eyes?"

"Iromie: Color Vision & Aging Experience" is a Mixed Reality (MR) tool designed to bridge the gap in visual understanding. Using advanced Passthrough technology, it simulates in real-time how your current surroundings appear to individuals with different color vision types or age-related visual changes.

[Key Features]

Color Vision Simulation: Experience various types of color vision, including Protanopia, Deuteranopia, and Tritanopia.
